_note: Season earnings per team, read from each team's own Liquipedia Results page. season_usd covers the window between the previous International and this one and EXCLUDES The International itself; ti_usd is that event alone. Figures are Liquipedia's stated amounts, not derived. A row showing "-" earned nothing and counts as zero; a row whose amount could not be read is listed in `unpriced` and counts as nothing at all, because unknown and zero must not look the same.
_whose_money: A Results page belongs to the organisation, so a team that changed players mid-season still shows one continuous history. The money is the org's, not that specific five.
